decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to aggressively play efficient creatures and burn spells to quickly reduce the opponent's life total. The strategy revolves around dealing direct damage to the opponent while using cards like Boros Charm and Skullcrack to prevent them from gaining life or stabilizing. The mana base is designed to support the low-curve aggressive playstyle, with a mix of red sources and utility lands like Sunbaked Canyon to help maintain card advantage. This deck aims to win the game as fast as possible by overwhelming the opponent with a constant stream of damage.

The deck utilizes the Underworld Breach combo to generate infinite mana and draw its entire deck to win the game quickly. It relies on cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Mishra's Bauble to recur spells from the graveyard and cycling through the deck efficiently. Dragon's Rage Channeler and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer provide early aggression and card advantage. The deck aims to set up the combo as quickly as possible while disrupting the opponent's game plan with Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat. Land base includes fetch lands and Urza's Saga for consistency and utility.

The main idea behind this Amulet Titan deck is to quickly ramp up mana and take advantage of powerful land-based combos to search for and play Primeval Titan. By using cards like Amulet of Vigor, Arboreal Grazer, and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove, the deck can generate a significant amount of mana and quickly find key lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Cavern of Souls. This allows the deck to overwhelm opponents with a large Primeval Titan and trigger devastating landfall effects.

This deck focuses on assembling an equipment combo quickly to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and spells. By utilizing cards like Stoneforge Mystic, Sigarda's Aid, and Colossus Hammer, the deck can create lethal threats early in the game. Devoted Druid and Puresteel Paladin help ramp up resources and provide additional utility to the combo. With the support of cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Urza's Saga, the deck aims to create a dominating board presence and outpace the opponent before they can react effectively.

The main idea of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy by playing efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear, Goblin Guide, and Eidolon of the Great Revel, while using burn spells like Lightning Bolt, Boros Charm, and Lava Spike to finish off the opponent or clear a path for your creatures to attack. Cards like Skullcrack, Searing Blaze, and Exquisite Firecraft also help to disrupt the opponent's game plan and prevent them from stabilizing. This deck aims to close out the game quickly before the opponent has a chance to establish their own strategy.

This deck focuses on quickly casting cascade spells to overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of powerful creatures and spells. By using cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck aims to cascade into high-impact cards like Crashing Footfalls and Archmage's Charm to put pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes versatile spells like Bonecrusher Giant and Brazen Borrower to deal with threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan. With a mixture of aggression and control elements, this deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver opponents in a fast-paced Modern environment.

The deck revolves around utilizing creatures with powerful abilities to create synergies and combos with cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution. The goal is to quickly assemble a toolbox of creatures that can be fetched as needed to disrupt opponents and win the game through various combos and synergies. Yawgmoth, Thran Physician is a key piece in the deck, providing a source of card advantage and removal. The deck aims to be versatile and adaptable to different matchups, utilizing a mix of aggressive creatures and disruptive elements.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly lower your own life total to power up Death's Shadow and utilize cards like Unholy Heat and Drown in the Loch to control the board and remove threats. The deck also includes efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler to apply pressure and disrupt the opponent. Additionally, cards like Mishra's Bauble and Thoughtseize help to dig through your deck and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra layer of consistency to the deck.

The deck focuses on using a variety of control elements to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan. It utilizes powerful cards like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Teferi, Time Raveler to control the board and generate value. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for extra value and card advantage. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent through incremental advantage gained from powerful creatures and spells while disrupting their strategy with counterspells, removal, and bounce effects. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with its flexibility and resilience.

This deck focuses on utilizing the Amulet of Vigor to generate extra mana and cheat out big creatures like Primeval Titan early in the game. With the help of cards like Azusa, Lost but Seeking and Arboreal Grazer, the deck can ramp up quickly and overwhelm opponents with powerful threats. Cards like Urza's Saga and Turntimber Symbiosis provide additional utility and searching capabilities to ensure the deck can consistently execute its game plan of getting out massive threats and winning through big combat swings or direct damage from Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle.

The main idea behind this deck is to ramp up mana quickly using cards like Azusa, Lost but Seeking and Cultivator Colossus, in order to play powerful combo pieces like Primeval Titan and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove. By using cards like Amulet of Vigor and Urza's Saga, the deck can generate strong board presence and put pressure on the opponent. The inclusion of utility lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Bojuka Bog give the deck additional versatility and options for different situations. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize creatures with enter-the-battlefield abilities to disrupt the opponent's strategy and control the board. By repeatedly blinking creatures like Skyclave Apparition and Flickerwisp using Aether Vial, players can remove threats, protect their own creatures, and outvalue their opponent. Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Leonin Arbiter also provide additional disruption by taxing the opponent or restricting their search abilities. With efficient removal in Path to Exile and powerful equipment like Sword of Fire and Ice, this deck aims to control the game and win through efficient combat and advantage.

This deck focuses on aggressively playing powerful creatures and disrupting the opponent's game plan with targeted removal and hand disruption spells. The goal is to control the battlefield while applying pressure to the opponent's life total, utilizing the synergy between cards like Liliana of the Veil, Tarmogoyf, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. The deck also includes versatile planeswalkers like Chandra, Torch of Defiance and Wrenn and Six to provide additional card advantage and board presence. With a mix of efficient threats and disruptive spells, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents quickly and decisively.

This deck focuses on using a combination of control elements and powerful Elemental creatures to dominate the battlefield. By utilizing cards like Fury and Solitude for removal, along with powerful Elementals like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Risen Reef for board presence, the deck aims to control the game until it can overwhelm the opponent with its array of threats. The inclusion of cards like Yorion, Sky Nomad and Ephemerate allows for additional flexibility and value generation, making the deck a versatile and potent force in Modern 1 vs 1 matchups.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on quickly developing a board presence with cheap, efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear, Sprite Dragon, and Soul-Scar Mage. The deck also includes a variety of instant spells like Lightning Bolt, Lava Dart, and Opt to control the board and protect your creatures. The goal is to apply pressure early and consistently while utilizing cards like Manamorphose and Expressive Iteration to maintain card advantage and keep the pressure on your opponent. By utilizing a mix of fast creatures and burn spells, this deck aims to quickly defeat your opponent before they can stabilize.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on playing efficient threats like Dragon's Rage Channeler, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Murktide Regent while disrupting the opponent with countermagic like Counterspell and Spell Pierce. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Unholy Heat and Lightning Bolt while maintaining card advantage through cards like Brazen Borrower and Expressive Iteration. The mana base is optimized for casting spells quickly, with a mix of fetch lands and utility lands. Overall, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent quickly while disrupting their game plan.
